# `open_focuser`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open the electronic focuser (main or wide GPIO focuser) and initialise its position scaling.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xccd10, Open @0x15b450 (64-bit build); tier INFERRED |

No parameters are read. Opens the selected GPIO focuser (handle 0 for the main camera, handle 1 for a supported wide camera), reads its hardware maximum step, builds the control list (max_step, backlash, reset_step plus a null-name sentinel entry) and initialises the position scaling. If the initialisation file is inaccessible an initial-move thread is started, so opening may cause motion; otherwise the initial move is skipped. An already-open focuser returns success. The inspected poll loop waits at most 30000 ms in 100 ms steps (not the total latency bound). No mount-parked check was found. Because the control list contains the null-name sentinel, a later get_focuser_caps cannot serialise its reply.

Side effects: Opens the focuser hardware handle, caches the hardware maximum and builds scaling state; may start an initial-move thread that moves the focuser. Events from that thread are unresolved.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 210 | The selected wide-camera model cannot autofocus | `not supported` |
| 201 | The focuser open call or the maximum-step query fails (the latter closes the handle again) | `fail to connect` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Internal IsMoving poll failures can set 300 or 318 but are suppressed once Open itself reports success. The exact model predicate behind 210 is unresolved.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":9,"method":"open_focuser"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"open_focuser","result":0,"code":0,"id":9}
```

Reply, open-failed - Hardware open failed:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"open_focuser","error":"fail to connect","code":201,"id":10}
```
